# Atd

> Atd (anything, anytime, anywhere, to do) is a free, open-source macOS AI desktop agent (MIT licensed). A native app for macOS 15 or later (Apple silicon or Intel) opens a floating panel on ⌘ ⇧ Space anywhere to run coding, computer use, MCP/skill workflows, screenshot and screen-recording captures, and automation with cloud or local models.

## Core Pages

- [Website (English)](https://atd.best/): product overview, workflow showcase, capabilities, and installers
- [Website (简体中文)](https://atd.best/zh): product overview and installers in Simplified Chinese
- [Blog & Release Notes (English)](https://atd.best/blog): release notes, newest first ([RSS feed](https://atd.best/feed.xml))
- [博客与更新日志 (简体中文)](https://atd.best/zh/blog): release notes in Simplified Chinese ([RSS feed](https://atd.best/zh/feed.xml))
- [Full LLM Reference](https://atd.best/llms-full.txt): generated full product and release notes reference in production builds

## Downloads & Source

- [Download for Apple silicon](https://downloads.atd.best/latest/Atd-arm64.dmg): newest stable installer for Apple silicon (macOS 15 or later); saves as `Atd-<version>-arm64.dmg`
- [Download for Intel](https://downloads.atd.best/latest/Atd-x64.dmg): newest stable installer for Intel Macs (macOS 15 or later); saves as `Atd-<version>-x64.dmg`
- Preview builds for [Apple silicon](https://downloads.atd.best/rc/Atd-arm64.dmg) and [Intel](https://downloads.atd.best/rc/Atd-x64.dmg): newest release candidate when newer than stable
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/JUNERDD/Atd): the native macOS shell, React UI, and local agent service
- [Releases](https://github.com/JUNERDD/Atd/releases): release notes and dmg installers per version
